items.title: This new concrete is stronger and pulls CO2 from the air
items.title_en: This new concrete is stronger and pulls CO2 from the air
items.title_zh: 这种新型混凝土强度更高，还能从空气中吸收二氧化碳
items.summary_en: Researchers have created a concrete mixture that is both stronger and capable of absorbing carbon dioxide. The best formula, combining zeolite with bamboo biochar, boosted compressive strength by 7.48% and tensile strength by 15% compared with conventional concrete. It also captured about 1.2 grams of CO₂ per day in laboratory testing.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员研制出一种既强度更高又能吸收二氧化碳的混凝土混合料。最佳配方将沸石与竹生物炭相结合，与传统混凝土相比，其抗压强度提高了7.48%，抗拉强度提高了15%。在实验室测试中，该混合料每天还能捕获约1.2克二氧化碳。
